working_definition: Early-dataset (0-24h APF) cluster named 'T2a' by the authors (Kurmangaliyev et al. 2020, GSE156455 metadata_early subtype); composed primarily of immature T2a cells of the developing optic lobe/eye.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult T neuron (Hormann et al., 2020).

justification: Authors name this early cluster T2a. FBbt has no immature T2a term; nearest parent with an immature form is immature T neuron (precursor to adult T neurons, which include T2a).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T neuron with its soma posteriorly adjacent to the gap between the medulla and lobula plate and a cell body fiber that projects along the proximal surface of the medulla before branching in the second optic chiasm (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Shinomiya et al., 2019). One branch projects into a medulla column, where it forms a bushy, fine, arborization in medulla layer M9 and then projects through the rest of the medulla column, bifurcating in medulla layer M5 and forming fine arbors throughout layers M1-4. The other branch forms a terminal arborization in lobula layer 3 that is much wider than a single column and has bleb-type terminal branches.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature/adult term; cells are 0-24h APF immature neurons.

recommendation: Broad match to immature T neuron; request immature T2a term only if fine granularity is wanted.
